result:
✓ Fixed. I've installed the rotated deploy key to the location the deploy script expects:

**What was wrong:** The deploy script looks for the key at `~/.ssh/deploy_key`, but the rotated key was left in the checkout at `./new_deploy_key`.

**What I did:**
- Copied `new_deploy_key` to `~/.ssh/deploy_key`
- Set proper permissions (600) on the installed key
- Made the deploy script executable

The deploy script at `scripts/deploy.sh` should now be able to locate and use the rotated key when it runs. The script will execute: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key deploy@release.internal "cd /srv/app && ./pull.sh"`
